::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 19 1894  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e.174 ff 143-4[^1]
:::

Dear [Mr Bullock](people/person_221.qmd),
If you can wait a little while for St Maurice I will send him to you but I am very busy just now, and could not turn my mind to it immediately. I have [Baring Gould](other_books/otherbook_692.qmd) and [Alban Butler](other_books/otherbook_27.qmd) both also Fleury[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd  J.F. Bullock/Radwinter Rectory/Saffron Walden. Postmark MR 19/94.
[^2]: CMY perhaps refers to Claude Fleury, *Histoire ecclesiastique* (1691-1720) ; she may have known it in Newman’s translation, *The Ecclesiastical History of M. l'abbé Fleury, from the Second Ecumenical Council to the end of the Fourth Century* (Oxford: Parker 1842-4).  She is talking about the work she was doing for Bullock's *Daily Lections* project.
